$comment: Window configuration — docs/WINDOWING.md §4.1. build.ts copies the `window` block verbatim into dist/manifest.json; the host reads it BEFORE cx.open_window, which is the only moment creation-time gpui options can be set without a visible flash. VN_WINDOW / VN_WINDOW_FOCUS still win on top.

window.title: vue-native — hello
window.$comment-titleBarFallback: LEFT AT ITS DEFAULT (true) on purpose. The host's fallback titlebar retires the first frame the app paints a `window-drag: move` region, and the one `[window]` log line that produces is part of what this demo demonstrates. The cost is that env(titlebar-area-height) is legitimately 0 for that one frame (m12 windowing-2 §8.11) — an app whose titlebar is sized purely by env() and cares about frame 1 sets this to false, which apps/oschrome now does.
